design.question: For each kind of thing the published sign identifications depict, do that kind's signs gather at the ends of inscriptions - asked per kind (other, human, animal, object_goods) on the graded Shakti corpus over the surface Spec 073 repaired, in this spec's own claim family; not Spec 071's retired question and not Hunt's claims in any form
design.populations: Primary: documented-lineage rows only, reproduced at step 0 as 3,045 analyzable rows / 557 distinct signs / 550 in sequences of length >= 2 (gate 0.4, POPULATION NOT REPRODUCED on disagreement). Sensitivity S3: documented + corroborated rows (5,131 analyzable), every quantity recomputed. Rows graded undocumented-uncorroborated enter no count anywhere
design.classes: The classes are Asset A v2's depicted kinds over Registry v2: other, human, animal, object_goods tested; the celestial class pre-registered EMPTY (0 signs) and reported first, never tested; unidentified signs members of no class and no comparison class (design R8, DD-075-4), counted in the census as context; token 999 the named exclusion (no published identity)
design.keying: DD-075-5: Spec 074's two-leg route (DD-074-8) - leg 1, a Shakti sign's ICIT code (its Wells number) resolved through Registry v2's parpola_1982 rows' wells_ids to exactly one Asset A v2 sign_key; leg 2, Registry v2's icit_wells rows, whose sign_id is the sign's own Wells code; zero or multiple resolutions across both legs is unkeyable and closes the execution at gate 0.4 as POPULATION NOT KEYED, token 999 excepted by name in advance
design.floors: Applied at the step-0 census, before any rate: at least 20 member signs (set just below the smallest identified kind, object_goods at 22 in Asset A v2) and at least 30 pooled primary-population occurrences; a kind failing either is TOO THIN, reported with its census, never dropped or merged
design.test: Per kind: the kind's pooled final-position rate against the pooled rate of its frequency-matched comparison class (the other identified kinds' signs in the kind's own member frequency band, Spec 071 sections 4.2-4.3 carried), Fisher's exact test (two-sided) on the pooled 2x2 at the 5% level; every member sign's own rate published in full beside the pooled result
design.verdicts: Per kind, frozen bands: SUPPORTED at enrichment ratio >= 1.5, Fisher significant at 5%, and at least half the kind's occurrences from signs individually above the corpus-wide final-position rate; NOT SUPPORTED at ratio <= 1.0 (the falsifier's word, stated in advance per kind); INCONCLUSIVE between; TOO THIN below a floor. Four verdicts, published together; no pooled depicted-kinds verdict exists
design.sensitivities: Per kind, beside the primary, never replacing its word: S1 borderline-removed (Asset A v2 carries 4 borderline rows); S2 contested-included under CISI-governed labels (Asset A v2 carries zero contested rows, so S2 is expected to equal the primary and is reported as such); S3 the corroborated sensitivity. Agreement across arms is not independence
design.osf: This spec files its own OSF registration at its freeze under the programme's OSF project; the filing is recorded in osf-spec-registration.md in this directory (registration id and DOI only, never the approval-token URL)
design.execution_gate: Phase 441 executes only against this frozen record, on the owner's order; step 0 asserts the repaired surface (gate 0.1), the Shakti intake under P-F1 S1/S2 (gate 0.2), input integrity (gate 0.3), population reproduction and keying (gate 0.4), publishes the census and applies the floors (gate 0.5), and gives the freeze-order proof from external records (gate 0.6) before any final-position quantity. Gate 0.4's population reproduction is flagged in the spec as a replay/drift gate: its quantities were verified at this freeze (adjudication section 2 and the C2 record)
design.limits: Position is not meaning; depiction is the published identification layer, not ground truth; Spec 037's 49 percent census caution travels with the asset and every verdict; one corpus, one (ICIT) lineage, named in every headline block; Spec 071's retirement and its reopening trigger stand untouched
